bullets.title: One Strange Rock
bullets.note: (“Gasp” episode, specifically).** This series is truly incredible. Executive produced by the acclaimed filmmaker [Darren Aronofsky](https://el2.convertkit-mail2.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7h5g97m/pgfeh9h2kn3845/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE3LzA5LzA5L2RhcnJlbi1hcm9ub2Zza3kvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==) (director of _Black Swan_, producer of _The Wrestler_, and much more) and hosted by Will Smith (@[willsmith](https://el2.convertkit-mail2.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7h5g97m/ketmh6h5gkd4n9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS93aWxsc21pdGgvP2hsPWVu)), it is unlike any documentary series I’ve ever seen. If interested in digging deeper into Darren’s creative process, you can listen to my interview with him: "[Filmmaker Darren Aronofsky — Exploring Creativity, Ignoring Critics, and Making Art](https://el2.convertkit-mail2.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7h5g97m/6mceh8h5vmk0l6/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE3LzA5LzA5L2RhcnJlbi1hcm9ub2Zza3kvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==).”

bullets.title: The Art of Spirited Away
bullets.creator: Hayao Miyazaki
bullets.note: _Spirited Away_—as mentioned in [my chat with Adam Savage](https://el2.convertkit-mail2.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7h5g97m/r7a8hoh39g2nmk/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE5LzA0LzMwL2FkYW0tc2F2YWdlLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj01YmY=)—is my favorite movie of all time. This book is awe-inspiring and shows the depth of world-creation that makes Miyazaki a legend.

bullets.title: Beats Antique
bullets.note: I find their instrumental tracks fantastic for writing flow. Pair with [Gramatik](https://el2.convertkit-mail2.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7h5g97m/l6hehmhn580wl2/aHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnNwb3RpZnkuY29tL2FydGlzdC8xNzlCcG1Ma1FDUklvVTY4Q284MGY1)’s upbeat instrumentals, and you’re set.

bullets.title: San Miguel de Allende
bullets.note: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, San Miguel has been ranked “2018 Best Small City in the World” by _Condé Nast Traveler_ (@[CNTraveler](https://el2.convertkit-mail2.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7h5g97m/77i7h8h6vrk397/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9DTlRyYXZlbGVy)). If you need convincing, check out [this slideshow from _Travel + Leisure_](https://el2.convertkit-mail2.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7h5g97m/znfghnhk9q40e2/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudHJhdmVsYW5kbGVpc3VyZS5jb20vdHJpcC1pZGVhcy9jaXR5LXZhY2F0aW9ucy9zYW4tbWlndWVsLWRlLWFsbGVuZGUtcGhvdG9zP3NsaWRlPTU4MDM1OCM1ODAzNTg=). Where else should I go in Mexico? Let me [know on Twitter (@tferriss)](https://el2.convertkit-mail2.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7h5g97m/xotph6hp85rxe5/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS90ZmVycmlzcw==) with hashtag #TimInMexico
